shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright monument surface
horizontal dividing bands separating zones of carving
small repeated symbolic signs (dense in A, sparse in B)
justification: Both are upright relief-carved monuments whose surfaces are divided by horizontal bands and include human/anthropomorphic imagery together with conventional symbolic signs, but that is about as generic as monumental relief gets. A is dominated by many rows of small, tightly packed script-like glyphs with two small kneeling figures facing inward in a bottom register, whereas B is a single large anthropomorphic mass with a headdress-like top and a few big curvilinear motifs and a central ring/disc on the chest — no shared specific motif, relationship or layout.
